Question:
Has the Board undertaken an annual
governance audit?

Does the governance framework recognize
the need to equitably treat all shareholders,
including the minority and foreign
shareholders?

Other than at the AGM, does the Board
facilitate the exercise of shareholders’ rights?

Does the Board facilitate shareholders
participation at the AGM?

Are minority and foreign shareholders
holding the same class of shares treated
equitably?

Does the Board proactively provide
information to shareholders and the media,
(and in a timely basis) on corporate affairs
and corporate governance?

Does the Board have a stakeholder-inclusive
approach in its practice of corporate
governance and which identifies and engages
its various stakeholders?

Has the Board developed policies,
procedures and strategies to manage
relations with different/key stakeholder
groups?
